what: 💡 How to Avoid Self-Contained Data Bloat (selfcontained = FALSE)
title: Interactive Virtualized Data Explorer Grid Widget
text: default, save_dtsmartr() embeds JavaScript libraries, CSS assets, data directly inside HTML file (selfcontained = TRUE), requires Pandoc. large datasets (e.g., thousands rows) environments without Pandoc, setting selfcontained = FALSE highly recommended. saves memory outputs lightweight HTML file alongside companion directory containing shared JS/CSS dependencies. [!NOTE] save_dtsmartr() passes skip_routing = TRUE internally main widget engine. guarantees large datasets like adlb (83k+ rows) successfully written disk widget export files, bypassing automatic external browser re-routing safeguard.
code: library(dtsmartr) library(pharmaverseadam)  # Save large ADLB clinical labs dataset without self-contained bloat save_dtsmartr(   data          = adlb,    file          = "outputs/adlb_report.html",    selfcontained = FALSE,    # Writes JS/CSS to 'outputs/adlb_report_files/'   open          = TRUE      # Opens resolved HTML in default browser )
